title: Falco bridge: Don't try to extract conversation fields if we're disabled
description:
If the Falco bridge dissector is disabled, we haven't passed anything on
to libsinsp we don't have any enriched data.

Fixes #20238

commits_data.title: Falco bridge: Don't try to extract conversation fields if we're disabled
commits_data.message:
Falco bridge: Don't try to extract conversation fields if we're disabled

If the Falco bridge dissector is disabled, we haven't passed anything on
to libsinsp and we therefore don't have any enriched data.

Fixes #20238
